WPWinter Park’s Trusted Practice

★★★★★

“I was terrified of the dentist so I just didn’t go. My kids convinced me Dr. Patel was awesome. I saw him knowing he was going to say my teeth were in complete disarray. That’s not what he saw — he saw someone who came to him willing to do what was needed to overcome a great fear. Each time we did procedures he explained exactly what he was doing and how everything fit into the master plan. He has won my continued support! His staff are simply amazing and I appreciate their kindness and compassion to me and my family!”

Linda G.

★★★★★

“Dr. Patel and his staff are simply the best! They do such a thorough and amazing job cleaning my teeth. Other places definitely rush through the cleaning to jam in as many patients as they can — not Dr. Patel’s office! They are all so nice and so professional. I would and do recommend Dr. Patel and his staff to anybody. If you are currently looking for a new dentist, absolutely go to Dr. Patel.”

Eric A.

★★★★★

“Dr. Patel and his staff are awesome! They are up to date with all of the latest procedures and practices. Explains issues, causes and options for correction in layman’s terms. Very positive atmosphere. Best dental practice I have ever been to.”

John O.

★★★★★

“I feel very comfortable and in good hands under the care of Dr. Patel and staff. I feel that my teeth and gums will be maintained and kept healthy. I am so lucky to have found him when I retired and I don’t miss my other dentist at all!”

Lucille S.

★★★★★

“This is a wonderful group of people who are all incredibly skilled, compassionate and caring. I had MAJOR dental problems and was written off by every dentist I visited. Thanks to him and his team and their attention to detail, I’m getting the best treatment and a new smile!”
